subject: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Choi <alex.choi@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation

Hi Alex — great to hear Novacorp is ready to see the Dedicated/Private flow end-to-end. To make sure we include the right folks (SE + procurement + security), proposing a short 45m working session: 25m demo + 15m procurement/security Q&A + 5m next steps.

We need a window that touches US, EU, and APAC stakeholders. Below are compact, rotating options (local times included) so your teams can pick a regular cadence or a one-off:

Option A (US-friendly):
- PDT: Tue 08:00–08:45 (PST) / EDT: Tue 11:00–11:45 / BST: Tue 16:00–16:45 / JST: Tue 00:00–00:45 next day

Option B (EU overlap):
- BST: Wed 15:00–15:45 / EDT: Wed 10:00–10:45 / SGT: Wed 22:00–22:45

Option C (follow-the-sun rotation — good for recurring demos):
- Week 1: APAC-evening slot (SGT 21:00)
- Week 2: US-morning slot (EDT 09:00)
- Week 3: EU-afternoon slot (CET 15:00)

If you can share the preferred attendees and any hard blackout windows (procurement cutoffs or security review times), we’ll lock the first session and include a short demo agenda (attached). Also sharing a Calendly if easier: https://calendly.com/redwood/dedicated-demo-30m (we’ll mark the invite as 45m).

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0193
From: Alex Choi <alex.choi@novacorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 12:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation

Thanks Dylan — that looks comprehensive. A few notes from my side:

- Procurement prefers meetings that end before 17:00 BST if possible (internal sign-off windows).
- Security wants the SE in the call to go over data residency and audit logs — please include them.
- I can loop in security@novacorp.com once we have a couple of candidate times.

For this first session, our core attendees will be:
- Alex Choi (Platform Lead)
- Priya Verma (Infra/Prod) — may need the technical deep dive
- Procurement (procure@novacorp.com)

Looking at calendars, two promising options for us: Option B (Wed 15:00 BST) or a slightly earlier EU-friendly slot Wed 14:00 BST. Can Marissa/Karthik confirm whether 14:00-14:45 BST works from an SE and runtime demo POV?

Appreciate the attached agenda.

— Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Choi <alex.choi@novacorp.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 14:46:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation

Hi Alex — thanks for the guidance. 14:00–14:45 BST is fine for the initial run; it gives us a clean 25m demo + 15m Q&A. A couple of prep notes so security/procurement get value:

- Karthik will cover audit logs, retention controls, and VPC/private deployment checklist (10m).
- I’ll show a short live trace of token-level latency and fallback routing (12m).
- We’ll reserve 15m for procurement/security questions and next-step actions (contract owner + technical follow-up list).

Attachment: I’ve added a short SE appendix to the demo agenda (Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) with exact screen captures we plan to use.

If procurement has a short questionnaire, please send it over before EOD tomorrow and we’ll annotate answers inline.

Also: if Novacorp wants a recurring cadence, a rotating week-to-week slot that alternates EU/US/APAC works well and we can automate invites so the organizer changes each week (we use a follow-the-sun rota template).

— Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procure@novacorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Alex Choi <alex.choi@novacorp.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation

Hi all — quick procurement note from our side:

- We prefer demo sessions that end by 17:00 local time for our evaluators (BST constraint noted).
- Can you avoid scheduling on Fridays — we do approvals on Mon–Thu.
- We attached our standard procurement intake (Novacorp-security-reqs.xlsx) with a few fields we need filled before we start legal redlines (expected runtime, data retention defaults, shared cloud regions).

Candidate slots we can confirm:
- Wed 02 Jun 2026, 14:00–14:45 BST
- Thu 03 Jun 2026, 10:00–10:45 BST (if you prefer earlier)

If you confirm Wed 02 Jun, we’ll RSVP and loop in the legal owner for a short intro after the demo.

Thanks,
Procurement Admin (on behalf of Novacorp Procurement)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procure@novacorp.com>, Alex Choi <alex.choi@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coord: multi-party demo — timeboxing options and rotation

Thanks everyone — locking Wed 02 Jun 2026, 14:00–14:45 BST per procurement preference. Calendar invite & agenda sent (45m invite, will show as 14:00–14:45 BST).

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: SE demo + latency trace + follow-the-sun rotation proposal (slide 4) — deliverable: updated agenda (done).
- Karthik: security/audit logs overview, annotate Novacorp-security-reqs.xlsx answers — please add comments by Tue 31 May.
- Alex: add legal contact to the invite once you have availability.

If anyone on Novacorp needs a slightly earlier slot, we can pivot to Thu 03 Jun 10:00 BST — please flag by EOD Mon. Otherwise we’ll proceed with Wed and record a short 10–12m clip of the technical section for any APAC folks who can’t attend.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
